description: Use this to draft a reply to a scored pitch: an interested reply, a request for salary and remote details, or a polite decline. It needs an evaluation_id from score_message or get_scoreboard; evaluations expire after 30 days. Errors: unknown_evaluation means score the pitch again with score_message and use the new evaluation_id; no_desk means call set_criteria first. Decision defaults to the recommended action. For a decline, ask the user whether to include the feedback card. Returns subject and body as a draft only; it never sends anything, and the user sends the reply themselves.

decision.description: Kind of reply. Defaults to the evaluation's recommended_action.

evaluation_id.description: The evaluation_id returned by score_message or get_scoreboard, such as "ev_3f9a1c2b". Evaluations expire after 30 days.

include_feedback.description: Only for decline: true appends a 3-line feedback card that says why the pitch did not fit. Defaults to false.

name: draft_response

as_of.description: Day of the call, as YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

body.description: Draft reply body, with the feedback card appended when asked for.

evaluation_id.description: The evaluation the reply is for.

feedback_card.description: The feedback card text, or null when not asked for or not a decline.

notes.description: Reminder that this is a draft and nothing is sent.

source.description: Where the data comes from: the user's own private desk.

title: Draft Response
